scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof supplied; exact finite verification is supplementary, not an infinite certificate. Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent checking.
scientific_limitations: Covers the full symmetric-group strong Bruhat order, not arbitrary intervals; computes inversion-graded first moments rather than the full degree distribution or degree variance. title: Inversion-graded Hasse-edge census of the strong Bruhat order
